result:
All 69 tests pass (`python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` → OK), including the new ones.

What was added:
- **`ledger/cli.py`** — new `--group-by {month,category,account}` flag on `report` (argparse rejects anything else with exit 2); `cmd_report` prints per-group totals when set, and the exact old summary when absent.
- **`ledger/report.py`** — `group_totals()` plus `render_group_totals_text/json` (text: one `<group> <total>` line per group, two decimals; json: one object with cent-rounded numbers; both ordered by label; months use `YYYY-MM`).
- **`ledger/store.py`** — `LedgerStore.totals_by(key)`, mirroring the existing `count_by`/`balances` style with exact Decimal cents.
- **`tests/test_cli.py`** — 6 new tests: month text, category json, account text, json label ordering, summary-unchanged-without-the-flag, and an invalid-group argparse error (covers all three keys, both formats).
- **`README.md`** — documents `--group-by` in the `report` usage block with a real worked example.

Changed files: `ledger/cli.py`, `ledger/report.py`, `ledger/store.py`, `tests/test_cli.py`, `README.md`.
